claims.statement: Tesla Q3 2026 update (2026-10-21): Megapack is used in off-grid and on-grid applications, supplying large data center loads and buffering oscillating demand 'with less local fossil fuel generation'; energy storage order rate and backlog at record highs. It does not name any specific onsite gas plant using Megapack.

aliases: hybrid battery and gas engine power system
nodes.name: Battery energy storage for load-swing buffering in onsite gas power

source_doc.permission_basis: SEC EDGAR 公開申報（8-K 附件季度更新）；只保留研究必要的有限逐字節錄。published_at 取 EDGAR 申報日 2026-10-21。
source_doc.title: Tesla 2026 第三季更新（8-K Exhibit 99.1，2026-10-21）：Megapack 用於離網與併網，供應大型資料中心負載、緩衝擺盪需求；儲能訂單率與在手訂單創新高；德州 Megafactory 投產（規劃 50 GWh）

sources.quote: Megapack excels in off-grid and on-grid applications, supplying large data center loads, buffering oscillating demand, helping interconnection grid-compliance and strengthening the grid – all with less local fossil fuel generation.

Demand for our Energy Storage business remained strong in the quarter, with our highest- ever order rate and backlog. Energy storage is the fastest way to add power to the existing grid and is critical to data center uptime.
